messages:
Ravi (People Ops): Quick announcement: final compliance push this week. Two items remain active mandatory Data Handling microtraining + annual SOC2 snapshot submission. Deadlines: training by 2026-04-07 23:59 UTC; snapshot uploads by 2026-04-09 23:59 UTC. Link: https://go.redwoodinference.com/compliance-spring-2026

Nina (Compliance): Please note the SOC2 snapshot is a one-file export (PDF or MD) showing your team's latest controls evidence. If you already uploaded incremental artifacts, bundle them and add a single index page.

Tom (Eng): Where do we put infra-level logs? They contain sensitive IPs.

Nina (Compliance): Redact ephemeral secrets. For logs with sensitive customer info, upload to the restricted evidence page and DM me the row.

Ops-bot: Reminder: Data Handling microtraining completion at 50% across the company.

Yara (Customer Success): Heads-up for CS: if you handle customer PII for demos, mark the snapshot and include the redaction note.

Tom (Eng): Uploaded snapshot (row 12). Added short index and redaction note.

Ravi (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 15:00 UTC in #help for anyone who needs help bundling. Final reminders will go out 48h before each deadline.

Nina (Compliance): If you need an extension for vendor/contractor artifacts, DM me with expected delivery date before 2026-04-05. We'll triage case-by-case.
